lines.en: I'm writing a letter to a friend.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, a letter? The friend in Busan, right?
lines.en: Yes, that's right. My hometown friend.

lines.learner: 아니요, 우표가 없어요. 우체국에 갈 거예요.
lines.en: No, I don't have one. I'll go to the post office.
lines.roman: Aniyo, upyoga eopseoyo. Ucheguge gal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: The post office is in front of the school, right?
lines.learner: 네, 맞아요. 지은 씨는 뭐 해요?
lines.en: Yes, that's right. What are you doing, Jieun?
lines.roman: Ne, majayo. Jieun ssineun mwo haeyo?

lines.beaver_en: I'm reading a book at home.
lines.en: Really? But why did you call?

lines.learner: 네, 맞아요. 새 전화번호는 문자로 보낼게요.
lines.en: Yes, right. I'll text you my new number.
lines.roman: Ne, majayo. Sae jeonhwabeonhoneun munjaro bonaelgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. But why did you change it?
lines.en: I got too many strange calls.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Will you send the letter today?
lines.learner: 네, 오늘 보낼 거예요. 내일 도착하지요?
lines.en: Yes, I'll send it today. It'll arrive tomorrow, right?
lines.roman: Ne, oneul bonael geoyeyo. Naeil dochakajiyo?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's fast. Well, call me again!
lines.learner: 네, 그럼 또 전화할게요. 안녕히 계세요.
lines.roman: Ne, geureom tto jeonhwahalgeyo. Annyeonghi gyeseyo.
